name: web-teal-and-orange-education-landing-with-mobile-and-hero-portrait-panel
title: Edubox landing page in deep teal, peach and orange with a hero portrait, category cards and a matching mobile screen on a teal gradient
whatItIs: A gradient backdrop (coral, yellow, teal) with a desktop page in peach and deep teal: a headline 'Build Your Skills on the Best Platform' with 'Best' in an orange pill, Get Started and Video Play buttons, student avatars, a portrait of a woman in a yellow hoodie on a striped peach card over teal, a row of category cards (Language, Graphic Design highlighted in teal, Content Writing, Finance) and an About block; beside it a phone with the same hero.
whatItMeans: Energetic and reassuring; teal and orange make education feel fresh.
techniques: Highlight one word in an orange pill.
Place the hero portrait on a striped card.
Highlight the selected category in teal.

vocabulary.definition: A headline word set inside a coloured pill.
A photo on a card with a wavy line pattern.
A card with an icon and a subject.
A row of small student portraits.
